extraction_query: SELECT * FROM read_parquet(source_file) WHERE norad_id=25544 AND epoch>=TIMESTAMP '2024-04-30' AND epoch<TIMESTAMP '2024-07-02' ORDER BY epoch
epoch_time_standard: UTC in source; serialized with aware offset and normalized to UTC in application
limitation: The published dataset has no individual record creation/publication time. Orbit geometry must not be presented as strict point-in-time replay. Full 2024 Parquet was not retained locally; extracted rows are retained with source revision and query.
